widgets_values:
You are an expert prompt engineer for text-to-image models. Your task is to expand the user's prompt into a highly effective image-generation prompt.

Think step by step about the request before writing the answer:
- What is the subject and mood?
- What visual styles, mediums, and lighting fit best?
- What composition, camera angle, and framing would strengthen the image?

Then produce ONE detailed, vivid, comma-rich prompt suitable for a diffusion model. Include concrete visual details (materials, lighting, colors, textures, atmosphere) and a clear composition. Do not explain your reasoning in the final answer - output only the expanded prompt itself.

a naked 35years old busty indian milf woman with big boobs lying in a forest on her back looking at camera in front of her showing her feet while 1 leg is bent and showing her veginal creampie getting G4NGB4NG by indian men

# THE FIVE TOGGLES

Dropdown on each IAMCCS_LazyAnySwitch node (title is on the node).

- **Text reference (AI description)** - Flux: OFF / Qwen: ON (default OFF)
  ON = the AI-written description of your REFERENCE IMAGE is prepended to your idea -> the prompt carries her identity in words.
  OFF = your idea alone (v7 behavior).

- **What to describe** - Flux: FULL IMAGE / Qwen: CHARACTER ONLY (default Qwen)
  Only matters when Text reference is ON.
  Qwen (CHARACTER ONLY) = describes JUST her (face, hair, body, clothes) - the scene comes from YOUR idea. Use for same character, new scenes.
  Flux (FULL IMAGE) = describes everything including the scene - use when you want the whole look recreated.

- **Enhancer** - Flux: OFF / Qwen: ON (default OFF)
  ON = the LLM expands your prompt before encoding. WARNING: the enhancer IS an LLM - it deflects/sanitizes explicit NSFW prompts. SFW/general ideas only. When Text reference is ON, leave this OFF - both enrich the prompt and stacking dilutes.

- **Identity (image reference)** - Flux: OFF / Qwen: ON (default OFF)
  ON = the reference image conditions generation directly (same face/body via ReferenceLatent). Needs the identity recipe: 12 steps, cfg 2.5, Kroma 0.

- **Upscale** - Flux: OFF / Qwen: ON (default OFF)
  ON = 1.5x latent upscale + second pass.

Lazy by design: the unselected branch of every toggle never executes.
Text reference ON + Identity ON = strongest consistency (AI words + image conditioning).
Note: the description runs on the 4B VL (already loaded with your gen stack). For richer descriptions, use the Image_to_Text workflow's 32B and paste the result into your idea.

# LoRAs

## Current stack (chained core LoraLoaderModelOnly - set strength 0 to turn any off)
Order matters (chained in this sequence):
1. **xCreampiex** @ 1.0 - replaces Kroma in the first slot. Prompt usage: "she has a vaginal creampie."
2. **Realism Engine krea2 v3.1** @ 0.6 - realism textures.
3. **Mystic XXX v3** @ 0.7 - NSFW content.
4. **Mombod epoch_7** @ 0.6 - body types. TRIGGER: "mombod" + describe the woman. (This is the epoch_7 variant on disk, not f2k9b-final-v2.)
5. **G4NGB4NG V1** @ 2.0 - TRIGGER WORD REQUIRED: "G4NGB4NG". Strength 1.0-3.0, works well with all LoRAs, models and styles.

NOTE: Kroma (refusal reduction) was REMOVED from the stack by the user - with cfg 3.0 guidance it is not needed, and dropping it improved results.

## Optional library (chain another LoraLoaderModelOnly per LoRA)
- **Innie / Labia Minora Slider** - not yet downloaded. CivitAI model 2811308, version 3170393, file labia_minora_krea2_loraholic.safetensors (6.9MB) via civicomfy.
  SLIDER: positive = larger (very potent), negative = smaller. Stable range -4.0 to 6.0, max -6.0 to 10.0. Won't make a complete innie slit alone - combine with other LoRAs.
- **NSFW Aesthetics V1** - not yet downloaded. CivitAI model 2818878, version 3179666, file Krea2_NSFW_Aesthetics_V1.safetensors (436MB) via civicomfy.
  Faces, body, pose diversity and context are excellent. BUT: tends to add a lot of grain and slightly reduce image quality - use at MAX 0.6. Works better for smaller images / basic generation.
- **Mombod f2k9b-final-v2** (alternate variant) - CivitAI. Describe the woman + trigger "mombod"; 0.3-2.0, best 0.5-1.2 (author 1.2-1.5). Sag/stretch marks/fupa done poorly by core models - crank the LoRA or soften the prompt. SDXL variant 0.4-0.8.

# IDENTITY + SETTINGS

## Current settings (user-tuned, giving very good results)
- 12 steps | cfg 3.0 | euler | simple | seed RANDOMIZE | denoise 1.0
- Upscale stage 2 (when on): 12 steps, cfg 5.0, denoise 0.45
- Reference: input/reference_gray.png (gray portrait - BiRefNet composite, BG_Removal_Gray workflow)
- Seed: randomize every run (no fixed seed)

## Identity recipe (when the Identity toggle = Qwen)
- Reference: a PORTRAIT (face + shoulders, no room in frame) composited on NEUTRAL GRAY.
  Make one with the BG_Removal_Gray workflow (BiRefNet -> gray composite). Transparent PNGs load as black and drag quality down.
- Prompt structure (lead with preservation - it carries the most weight):
  "KEEP the same woman and change the setting: <new scene>. Preserve exact facial identity, makeup, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, and accessories from the reference image."
- Identity = same PERSON (face, hair, body, outfit), NOT the same pose.
- Setting bleed: the reference's environment comes along - always use a clean portrait, and say "CHANGE THE SETTING COMPLETELY" for a full scene swap.

## General
- Negative: real prompt (even empty) - never ConditioningZeroOut
- 1024x1024 base (1536x1536 when upscale on)
- Hero shots come from pure T2I (identity off) + great prompts; identity is for continuity.

# V7 - What changed

- **v7 = v4, simplified.** Structure/depth control REMOVED (the depth LoRA gave bad results on the merged Turbo - it was trained on Raw). The second LoadImage and the whole depth chain are gone.
- **ONE LoadImage only** - the identity portrait. Reference = who she is, nothing else.
- **No i2i/editing for Krea 2** - Qwen-Image-1 handles instruction editing better and will get its own setup later. Krea 2 stays pure generation + identity.
- The IAMCCS_LazyAnySwitch is just the toggle mechanism for the Flux/Qwen switches - not extra machinery.

## White noise? Troubleshooting
- Most likely the Upscale two-pass (nearest-exact latent upscale + denoise 0.45). Fix: stage-2 denoise -> 0.3, or LatentUpscale method -> bilinear.
- Identity ON at cfg 2.5: if noise appears, drop cfg to 2.0.
- Note which toggle is on when it happens.

nodes.title: DESCRIBE: CHARACTER ONLY (system prompt)
widgets_values: You are an expert at extracting character identity descriptions for AI image generation. Look at the attached image and describe ONLY the person, in exhaustive fixed detail: age, ethnicity, build, face shape and features, skin tone, hair (color, length, style), eyes, and distinctive marks (freckles, moles, scars), plus exactly what they are wearing (every garment, color, fabric, accessory). IGNORE the background, scene, pose and camera angle completely - those will change between images. Write one vivid natural-language paragraph of 120-200 words, subject-first. Natural language only - no tags, no weight syntax.

nodes.title: DESCRIBE: FULL IMAGE (system prompt)
widgets_values: You are an expert image describer for AI image generation. Describe the attached image in exhaustive natural-language detail: the subject (age, gender, ethnicity, build), face and hair, clothing, pose and action, the scene and background, lighting, colors, style, and camera framing. Write one vivid flowing paragraph of 150-250 words, subject-first, portrait order (person, clothing, face, pose, background). Natural language only - no tags, no weight syntax.
